items.title: AI agents help rescue ETH’s Glamsterdam fork, ‘Steal My Bitcoin’ site: Hodler’s Digest
items.body: Similar to the Hugging Face hack, Ethereum researchers have set up an AI Agent message board to help rescue the Glamsterdam fork. ‘Steal My Bitcoin’ site successfully hacked.

items.title: Ethereum Delays Glamsterdam Testnet Fork Over Gas Security Flaws
items.body: The Hoodi testnet fork is off after ChainSecurity found gas changes that could let contracts lock in failures, citing 13 real-world cases.

items.title: Ethereum delays Glamsterdam Hoodi testnet launch over security risks
items.body: ChainSecurity said it identified 13 real-world examples of smart contracts potentially affected by Glamsterdam’s gas changes and is coordinating responsible disclosure with affected…

items.title: Starknet voters back research into life beyond Ethereum
items.body: StarkWare plans to release a draft whitepaper in November as it explores an independent, quantum-resistant blockchain.

items.title: Ether ETF outflows continue, pass $1B in October so far
items.body: US spot Ether ETFs have shed $1.08 billion so far in October, the biggest monthly outflow of 2026, while Bitcoin ETF inflows slowed after Monday’s spike.

items.title: JPMorgan takes JPM Coin to Ethereum for institutional clients
items.body: JPMorgan is expanding its JPM Coin deposit token to Ethereum, allowing institutional clients to make payments and settle tokenized asset transactions.
